title: Discover sufficient local inputs with a paid noisy response oracle
statement: The producer reports a shared random-hashing construction that avoids enumerating n^k input subsets,learns sufficient local inputs for uniform rate recovery without a minimum edge-strength assumption,and pays the driven endpoint response acquisition and calibrated local noise inversion.

requires: The same binary-spin/known-Lambda/calibrated-local-control model as the finite-drive local inverse. Randomized base targets and shared O(k^2)-bucket hashes,with responses for all outputs per target.

Approximate drift-value interface g_i(x)=-2x_i c_i(x_Bi),F_i(a)=r(E_piA X_i-a_i)=E_piA g_i(X),with ||F_i-g_i||_infinity<=4kLambda^2/(r+Lambda). Required response tolerance u is physically acquired,not a free exact oracle.
provides: In an isolating hash,a full-bucket response change>6u identifies a decodable signal and binary-coded subset comparisons at threshold2u recover its index. At most one vote per candidate per hash and majority filtering reject collision-generated candidates.

Inputs with some edge effect>8u are retained;omitted weak inputs have bounded uniform effects whose telescoping gives uniform rate approximation. This is not exact support recovery of arbitrarily weak edges.

The reported target-setting count is Q=O(2^k k^2[k+log(n/delta)]log(n/delta)log n). At fixed k,it is polylogarithmic in n,with sparse candidate processing rather than all k-subset enumeration. Full measurement and output processing costs are not polylogarithmic by assertion.

For tolerance u,the source sufficient physical settings are r>=12kLambda^2/u,tau=log(6r/u)/(r-(k-1)Lambda),J>=(72rLambda/u^2+16r/u)log(6nQ/delta) endpoints per target. Stationary approximation,finite hold and sampling each get u/3. Total is QJ complete snapshots and nQJ scalar readouts.

For calibrated noisy writes,the target is h_i=T_eta g_i with the same relevant inputs. Hash h_i,then invert the KNOWN noise channel only on its selected local table,with amplification<=q_min^-k. No n-variable deconvolution. Variance pays an r^2 eta_max term;the displayed sufficient cost scales epsilon^-4 at fixed positive reset error.
assumptions: The noisy control law is known and independently calibrated;unknown backaction can make native rates unidentifiable. A small residual on a wrong smaller neighborhood does not certify state sufficiency.
The reported hashing experiments test a bounded-error response interface;they do not execute the full sufficient QJ physical sampling budget.
costs: The same-data eight-variable/64-rate comparison was WON by full-state maximum likelihood:reported RMSE0.02545 versus local inversion0.02865. The stated distinction is local operator size and acquired control interface,not blanket statistical superiority.

Producer reports retained six-variable/two-absorber endpoints,large-outgoing star tests,noisy inverse and hashing/deconvolution fixtures. Original datasets/code/review notes remain held and unacquired;no Capital rerun.

A reported95% simultaneous certificate0.55849 covered actual synthetic max error0.13587;incorrect small-neighborhood validation could appear consistent until an enlarged-neighborhood check. Acquisition,calibration and observed-state completeness remain charged.
